_comment: THE home content file. Every image, word and link the home page and its section pages
render, in one place, with a stable id on each entry.
It has three jobs. It is the OFFLINE FALLBACK — the app renders from this whenever the
backend is unreachable or has never been published to, so home is never blank. It is the
LINK REGISTRY — every tap target on home is a { route, params } pair here rather than a
nav.navigate buried in JSX. And it is the SEED for the backend's cms_sections/cms_items
tables (backend/src/db/seed/cms-home.ts reads a copy of this file).
Shape is identical to the GET /cms/home response, so it drops in as a substitute for one.
The only extra is `gender` on items: a server response is already filtered for the caller,
this file carries every audience and the app filters it.
Once the backend has been published to, the DATABASE is the source of truth and this file
is only the fallback. Refresh it from a published snapshot when it drifts far enough to
